evals.prompt: run qa-run-chatbot on PROJ-123. ENV=staging EVID_ROOT=/abs/evid DRIVER=chrome
evals.expected_output: TICKETS mode: fetches PROJ-123 + comments through the issue_tracker adapter, mines failure modes, builds >=5 cases across the type distribution, materializes set.json, resolves the base URL from app.environments.staging.url and the chat route from integrations.chatbot.entry_path, drives the live driver (browser.live_driver) via cookbook A+B, writes chatbot-run.json that validates; per-case evidence includes independent UI reads; brain writes listed in notes.

evals.prompt: run the chatbot set. SET_FILE=/abs/evid/smoke-chat/set.json APP_URL=http://localhost:3000 EVID_ROOT=/abs/evid DRIVER=cli AUTH_DIR=/abs/evid/smoke-chat/auth
evals.expected_output: SET_FILE mode: loads the inline set (no tracker call), headless cli driver with the runner-minted auth bundle, never calls AskUserQuestion, artifact validates.

evals.expected_output: If the live browser session's workspace != 'Example Org': BLOCKED(env) with the exact tenant-mismatch reason. Never switches the user's workspace, never asks.

evals.expected_output: Triggers; grades by independent read (the project's Tasks list / API), a claimed-success-empty-UI case lands FAIL class no-persistence with verbatim evidence.

evals.prompt: run the chatbot set. SET_FILE=/abs/evid/smoke-chat/set.json ENV=staging EVID_ROOT=/abs/evid
evals.expected_output: With integrations.chatbot.entry_path null in stack.config: writes chatbot-run.json with status BLOCKED, every case BLOCKED class env, summary 'config-missing:integrations.chatbot.entry_path'. Never guesses a chat route, never asks.
